documentation: Use //! for crate/module documentation and /// for public items.
Include applicable Examples, Errors, Panics and Safety sections; keep examples suitable for doctests.
Unsafe APIs must explain caller obligations; unsafe blocks need local SAFETY comments establishing their invariants.
rules: Use existing rustfmt configuration and preserve import groups.
Express recoverable failures with Result; handle or propagate errors with ?.
Avoid unjustified unwrap/expect in business paths; explain intentional panic conditions.
Keep ownership and borrowing explicit; do not introduce unsafe solely to bypass borrow checking.
